race.description: Hyoketsu Summer Series On Sale Mdn
race.comment: RAKITIN (5) stands out with two solid runs at Belmont and now faces an easier field after finishing fourth, just a length behind Just Kick. He led early but got caught late, following a third-place finish where he was narrowly beaten by Bourbonontherocks, making his 1400m form reliable for this maiden. MAKE ME TURN (13) shows promise after a fourth-place debut at Belmont Park, only 1.5 lengths back, and her inside draw enhances her chances to improve. Looks an improver getting out in trip today. BADGER BOB (2) was overlooked first-up at Ascot but made ground to finish sixth, just over two lengths behind, and should be fitter second-up with barrier 1 favorable. DIVINE MIRAGE (12) has the best recent placing after a third at Ascot, where she was held up but still finished close to Mystic Smile. Has claims on the back of that performance. FABULOUS MASCHINO (14) finds a suitable race on debut and won't be far away.
